title: Distinct Keystroke Stretch
brief: A password strength analyser looks at the raw keystroke string a user typed. One of its signals is how long a stretch of consecutive keystrokes goes by without any key being pressed twice.
Implement longestDistinctRun(s), where s is the keystroke string, and return the length of the longest unbroken stretch of s in which no character appears more than once.
